title: Bounds for the cutoff ramp
statement: For real numbers $\eta>0$ and $v$, the cutoff ramp takes values in $[0,1]$ at every real $x$. It equals $1$ whenever $x+\eta\le v$ and equals $0$ whenever $v\le x$.
